description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Slap Env Controller (SLAP_ECO) component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization routines.

methods.name: SlapCreateEnvController
methods.description: Creates an environment controller handle given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapEcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the SLAP Eco object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SlapEcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the given SLAP Eco object.

methods.name: SlapEcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the SLAP Eco object.
